mapper.insert: insert into gym.member_course (course_id, course_name, user_id, user_name, status, order_num) value (#{courseId},#{courseName},#{userId},#{userRealName},#{status},#{orderNum})
mapper.update: update gym.member_course set status = #{status} where id = #{courseId}
